backgrounds.name: Aethel City Guard Veteran
backgrounds.sourceEquipment: A piece of your old uniform (e.g., a dented helmet or worn insignia), a map of Aethel's main districts, a set of common clothes, manacles, and a belt pouch containing 10 gp.
backgrounds.physicalMapping: Uniform insignia uses small narrative token unless an actual larger item is chosen; map uses small document; common clothes, manacles, pouch and coins use named catalog items.
backgrounds.notes: Preserve all description and every actual item. Make and record actual source choices/unspecified finite quantities at creation; no automatic spells/proficiency.

backgrounds.name: Rift Scarred Survivor
backgrounds.sourceEquipment: A strange trinket from the other side (e.g., a shard of obsidian that hums faintly, a feather that never gets dirty), a tattered map of a place that doesn't exist on Aethel, a set of traveler's clothes, an amulet to ward off bad luck, and 5 gp.
backgrounds.physicalMapping: Trinket and luck amulet use small narrative tokens; map uses small document; traveler clothes and coins retain their named profiles.
backgrounds.notes: Preserve all description and every actual item. Make and record actual source choices/unspecified finite quantities at creation; no automatic spells/proficiency.

backgrounds.name: Disgraced Noble Scion
backgrounds.sourceEquipment: A set of fine clothes (perhaps slightly worn), a signet ring bearing a tarnished or altered family crest, a letter detailing your disgrace (or a forged letter proclaiming your innocence), and a purse containing 25 gp (perhaps the last of your inheritance).
backgrounds.physicalMapping: Fine clothes and signet ring retain normal profiles; letter uses small document; purse uses pouch. Source worn appearance alone does not invent mechanical damage.
backgrounds.notes: Preserve all description and every actual item. Make and record actual source choices/unspecified finite quantities at creation; no automatic spells/proficiency.

backgrounds.name: Wildling Herbalist
backgrounds.sourceEquipment: An herbalism kit, a staff carved with natural symbols, a collection of dried herbs and rare flowers, a set of common clothes made from animal hides, and a belt pouch containing 5 gp.
backgrounds.physicalMapping: Herbalism kit; carved staff uses quarterstaff; one finite dried-herb/flower bundle; common clothes, pouch and coins.
backgrounds.notes: Preserve all description and every actual item. Make and record actual source choices/unspecified finite quantities at creation; no automatic spells/proficiency.

backgrounds.name: Guild Artisan Dropout
backgrounds.sourceEquipment: A set of artisan's tools you managed to keep, a sample of your best work (now perhaps used for mundane tasks), a letter of resignation (or expulsion) from your guild, a set of traveler's clothes, and a belt pouch containing 15 gp.
backgrounds.physicalMapping: Select one actual artisan-tool item. Retain best-work sample description and choose its actual comparable profile, with no inferred hidden power. Letter, traveler clothes, pouch and coins use normal profiles.
backgrounds.notes: Preserve all description and every actual item. Make and record actual source choices/unspecified finite quantities at creation; no automatic spells/proficiency.

backgrounds.physicalMapping: Rubbing uses small document; myth book uses Book; select an ordinary holy-symbol profile; common clothes and coins. New agreed quantity completion: one incense block; no unlimited incense.
backgrounds.notes: Preserve all description and every actual item. Make and record actual source choices/unspecified finite quantities at creation; no automatic spells/proficiency.

backgrounds.notes: Preserve all description and every actual item. Make and record actual source choices/unspecified finite quantities at creation; no automatic spells/proficiency.
